body: Ran /sc:spec-panel-ponytail --fix-audit once through the sc-fix-audit script (prepare, ponytail-review audit, check CHECK_OK, apply); the spec was edited only by the script, and the pre-audit copy is at review/fix-audit/current-before-audit.md. Result is audit: applied(reverted=1, shrunk=1, kept=12): the M3 hunk H8 was reverted to the baseline and the unattributed WC-10 citation split (H2) was trimmed, while every blocking fix (NF1-NF7) stays in place; three more shrink edits I proposed (a repeated NF1 sentence in WC-5 and 7.2 step 4, and UNVERIFIED item 19 about the --run-dir name) were skipped by the script because another row keeps the same hunk. Left for the coordinator: run review 3, then the skill's verdict step on the review-3 report (review 3 must not read fix-audit/audit.md); closed-minor.txt lists M3.
